title: Covalent organic framework membranes for energy storage and conversion
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,5675-5739
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE00494B, Review Article
Liyu Zhu, Yu Cao, Ting Xu, Hongbin Yang, Luying Wang, Lin Dai, Fusheng Pan, Chaoji Chen, Chuanling Si
In this review, current research progress on the utilization of COF membranes for energy devices is first comprehensively reviewed in terms of the core features, design principles, properties, and applications.
